With the Harry Potter reboot officially on the way, the Wizarding World might finally have what it’s been missing all along… a consistent foundation.

For years, fans have been asking for a Marauders series—James, Sirius, Lupin, Peter, Lily, Snape… the story feels like a no-brainer. So why hasn’t it happened yet?

Today, we’re breaking down the real reason a Marauders show has never quite worked before… and why the upcoming HBO reboot might finally change everything.

From inconsistent film canon, to missing lore, to the deeper story between James and Snape, this is the key piece the Wizarding World has been missing—and why a Marauders series might actually make sense now.

Could this be the beginning of a true Harry Potter expanded universe?
